minesweeper.audience: players who want to play minesweeper for fun
minesweeper.primary_goal: Let a player play a classic minesweeper round with clear rules, reveal and flag mechanics, and a win or loss outcome.
minesweeper.scope_summary: A single-player minesweeper game consisting of a grid board, mine placement, cell reveal and flag interactions, and game state tracking through win or loss.
model_focus: board grid and cell state (hidden, revealed, flagged)
game session state and outcome (in progress, won, lost)
out_of_scope: admin or back-office management of games
assumptions: Single-player, played locally or in a browser session without persistence across devices
Standard board difficulty presets are acceptable; custom rules are not required

kanban.audience: members of a small team tracking their shared work
kanban.primary_goal: Let the team see what work exists, what stage each item is in, and who is doing it, by moving cards across columns on a board.
kanban.scope_summary: A single kanban board per team, made of ordered columns containing cards that team members create, edit, assign, and move between columns.
model_focus: boards and their ordered columns (workflow stages)
cards representing work items, with title and description
card position and movement between columns
assumptions: Each board belongs to one team and is used only by its members.
Column names are set by the team rather than fixed by the system.

salon.primary_goal: Let clients see available appointment times and book a hair salon service without phoning the salon.
salon.scope_summary: A single booking page where clients choose a service and time slot and submit their contact details to create a booking.
model_focus: Client booking requests with contact details
assumptions: The salon owner manages the service list and availability outside this page, and the page only reads them.
Clients do not need accounts; booking requires only name and contact details.
